ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a voltage-divider biased common-emitter transistor amplifier circuit, and the transistor is labeled VT. The base is voltage-divider biased by Rb1 and Rb2, and the input signal ui is applied to the base through the coupling capacitor C1; the collector is connected to +Ucc through Rc, and the collector node is also connected to the load resistor RL on the right through the coupling capacitor C2, with the output voltage uo marked across RL; the emitter has Re, and is AC bypassed by the bypass capacitor Ce. Reasoning: Under normal mid-frequency small-signal amplification conditions, C2 is approximately a short circuit for AC, so when RL is connected, the collector AC load is the parallel connection of Rc and RL, namely Rc||RL. If RL is disconnected, it is equivalent to an open load, and the collector AC load becomes Rc||∞ = Rc. Since Rc is greater than Rc||RL, the voltage gain magnitude of the common-emitter amplifier is approximately proportional to the collector equivalent load, so after RL is disconnected, the voltage amplification factor increases.

raw_record.question_text: As shown in the figure, under normal amplification conditions, what happens to the voltage amplification factor of the circuit if the load resistor \(R_L\) is disconnected?

method.method_draft: Convert the shown circuit to its midband small-signal equivalent. Since C2 couples RL to the collector for AC, the effective collector load is Rc||RL when RL is connected. If RL is disconnected, RL becomes an open circuit, so the effective collector load changes to Rc||∞ = Rc. Because Rc is larger than Rc||RL, the gain magnitude increases. Therefore the voltage amplification factor increases.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个分压偏置的共射极三极管放大电路，三极管标为 VT。基极由 Rb1、Rb2 分压偏置，输入信号 ui 通过耦合电容 C1 加到基极；集电极通过 Rc 接到 +Ucc，集电极节点又通过耦合电容 C2 接到右侧负载电阻 RL，输出电压 uo 标在 RL 两端；发射极有 Re，并由旁路电容 Ce 对交流旁路。推理：在正常中频小信号放大条件下，C2 对交流近似短路，所以接上 RL 时，集电极交流负载为 Rc 与 RL 的并联，即 Rc||RL。若 RL 断开，相当于负载开路，集电极交流负载变为 Rc||∞ = Rc。由于 Rc 大于 Rc||RL，共射放大器的电压增益幅值与集电极等效负载近似成正比，因此断开 RL 后电压放大倍数增大。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the figure as a common-emitter BJT amplifier: the collector has resistor Rc to +Ucc, the emitter has Re bypassed by Ce, the input is coupled through C1, and the output load RL is coupled from the collector through C2 to ground.

method.method_draft: Treat the transistor stage and collector network as an amplifier with a nonzero output resistance feeding the load RL through C2. When RL is present, it loads the output and lowers uo for the same input ui. Disconnecting RL removes this loading, so the output voltage amplitude rises while the input is unchanged. Hence the ratio uo/ui, i.e. the voltage amplification factor, increases.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个三极管 VT 放大电路，左侧输入信号 ui 通过耦合电容 C1 加到基极；Rb1、Rb2 构成基极偏置；集电极通过 Rc 接到 +Ucc；发射极有 Re，并由 Ce 旁路；集电极信号再通过输出耦合电容 C2 接到右侧负载电阻 RL，输出电压 uo 标在 RL 两端。推理：在正常放大条件下，可把该晶体管级及其集电极网络看作具有非零输出电阻的放大器，经过 C2 向 RL 供给输出。RL 接入时会对输出端形成负载，使同一输入 ui 下的输出电压幅值降低；若断开 RL，负载效应被去除，输出电压幅值增大，而输入 ui 不变。因此电压放大倍数 uo/ui 增大。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Uses a qualitative loading/output-resistance argument rather than writing the transistor gain formula; distinct because it reasons from load removal and voltage division at the output port.
planner_metadata.image_role: Identify from the image that RL is on the output side after coupling capacitor C2, connected between the output node uo and the bottom reference line, so it acts as the external load on the amplifier output.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A finite load connected to an amplifier output draws signal current and causes loading; with the amplifier’s internal output resistance, this reduces the output voltage.
